integrity: Exact state census, affine regular action, and graph distances reproduced using separately implemented finite algorithms.
scientific_limitations: Finite result for the named Paley graph; enumeration and group distances reproduced by complete standalone checkers; no claim for other orders or for ordinary one-token movement; priority not independently established.
title: Two-point mobility and a Cayley geometry for the maximum cliques of the Paley graph of order 41
